content.stem: 代理银行业务被视为风险较高的银行业务领域,因为代理银行交易:

options.A: 主要是在高风险司法管辖区之间进行的
options.B: 可以匿名进行，且无需提供受益所有权信息
options.C: 通常包含的信息少于国内支付的信息
options.D: 是跨境的以及代表第三方进行的

content.stem_en: Correspondent banking is considered a high-risk area because correspondent banking transactions:

options_en.A: Are made primarily to and from high-risk jurisdictions
options_en.B: Can be made anonymously and without beneficial ownership information
options_en.C: Typically include less information than domestic payments
options_en.D: Are made cross-border and on behalf of third parties
